release_boundary: October 07, 2026 webinar and October 19, 2026 Camp, all email actions disabled
blocking_dependency: A registered, approved server operation and supported Kajabi/provider final-payment interception that disables every campaign direct-checkout bypass. Generic proposal approval and post-payment capacity sync do not create that interception.

required_adapter_contract.identity: Authenticated server-resolved contact identity; never a client attendance/waitlist/purchased flag
required_adapter_contract.offer_allowlist: Fresh verified registry/Kajabi AUD and USD recurring offers only; setup, monthly, renewal and cancellation disclosures
required_adapter_contract.code: Private server secret/digest; no code in page source, JavaScript, URLs or emails
required_adapter_contract.state: Fresh complete commerce/cohort and waitlist fetch-back, revision checked within serializable capacity reservation
required_adapter_contract.capacity: One durable transaction across authorization, payment start and accepted ledger. SQLite here is a local fixture only.
required_adapter_contract.payment_start: Revalidate server stage, code/waitlist access, offer terms, reserved capacity and exact cutoff at the irreversible payment boundary
required_adapter_contract.reconciliation: Provider/Kajabi fetch-back verified attempt, contact, offer, currency and setup/monthly amounts; accept or release only a verified final outcome
required_adapter_contract.inflight: A payment begun before close retains its reserved place while pending. Authorization alone does not permit payment after close.
required_adapter_contract.audit: Declared registered actor, correlation_id, tenant_id, source, confidence and expiry; approval queue and action audit through Memory API
required_adapter_contract.client_access: Browser uses existing front door, never directly calls Memory API
required_adapter_contract.replay: Review real recording including closing code, publish actual timestamp, enforce origin access for 72 hours and revoke all raw media paths at expiry
required_adapter_contract.email: No transports, schedules or email actions enabled. Eligibility evaluation cannot write a delivered ledger.
required_adapter_contract.registered_identity: Dedicated registered capability and policy, human approval and scoped executor; no borrowing another agent JWT or browser bypass
required_adapter_contract.abuse_protection: Server code-attempt throttle and reservation limits per authenticated contact and trusted edge IP; no code/existence oracle; production parameters require operator approval

proposal_body.source: CFB-002 reviewed native setup Doc and local source acceptance
proposal_body.rationale: Prevent pre-opening, wrong stage, invalid code, direct URL, stale tab, oversold capacity and post-cutoff payments without changing existing entitlements or prices.

expected_state_preconditions.purchase_count: re-fetch and reconcile; never assume zero from remaining capacity
